name: Flint
direction: Elder reedy contralto; light Polish accent; short phrases, dry wit, and precise endings.
description: An elderly woman in her seventies with a narrow, reedy contralto and a light Polish accent in fluent English. Papery texture, lightly rolled consonants, and very clear words. Short deliberate phrases with a tiny pause before the final word. Wry and alert, with warm amusement underneath her brisk certainty. Natural conversational English. Clean studio recording.
text: The road is quiet this morning. Come inside, and tell me where you are going. We can find a place for your horses.
